topics.title: RULES -- read this before you post
topics.author: gprewitt

posts.author: gprewitt
posts.body:
This is the swap board. It is for buying, selling and giving away things in Verity County.

It is here because Buy, Sell, Trade on the [url=synth://boards.gridfall.net/board/b-classifieds]main boards[/url] is four clicks down and most of the people who want a chest freezer do not know it is there. Dave has given me a subdomain and a copy of the board script and that is the whole arrangement. He is not responsible for anything I do with it.

[b]1.[/b] Local. If you cannot drive to it inside an hour it is not local.
[b]2.[/b] No dealers. If you do this for a living you already have somewhere to advertise.
[b]3.[/b] Say where the thing is. Gridfall, Halsey, out past Ashkettle, whichever.
[b]4.[/b] Edit your subject to SOLD when it is sold. The button is at the top of your own post.
[b]5.[/b] Cash, in person. Do not put your bank details or your phone number in the open, use the message button.
[b]6.[/b] Photos are fine. 200kb limit, because I pay for this by the gigabyte.

There is no rule about prices and I am not making one today.

topics.title: This board closes on 30 September
topics.author: gprewitt

posts.author: gprewitt
posts.body:
As of the 30th of this month this board will be read only.

The Swap Shop has been part of the Gridfall community since 2009 and we would like to thank everyone who has used it over the years. All existing content will remain available at this address.

Buying and selling can continue in Buy, Sell, Trade on the [url=synth://boards.gridfall.net/board/b-classifieds]main boards[/url], which has been there the whole time.

Registration here is closed as of today. Posting closes at midnight on the 30th. I am told the archive stays up for as long as the domain does.

I was not going to write this today and I have written it anyway. That is the announcement.

[EDIT 30/09/2016: posting is off. Anything you still want to shift, the main boards are there. If you cannot register over there either, I have not got an answer for you.]

[EDIT 2019: they shut registration on the main boards in February 2017, five months after I sent everybody to them. There is a newer one at [url=synth://gridfallswap.net/]gridfallswap.net[/url] and it does take new members. I am leaving this page where it is because people still find things in it.]

posts.author: gnash_88
posts.body: That is the substation the morning after the fire.

posts.author: tj_falk
posts.body:
So it is. Wrong thing off my favourites.

I cannot find mine now. It might have been on tape. Ignore me.

posts.author: gnash_88
posts.body: Is any of this still going

posts.author: tj_falk
posts.body:
Truck is gone. The whole thing went to Vasko for scrap in April, with the engine still in it, which I know.

I got $140 and it took four of us and a winch and most of a Saturday, so it worked out at about nine dollars an hour each and a good day out. [url=synth://vasko-salvage.synth/]Vasko[/url] weighed it in front of me, which is more than the last place did.

Thanks everybody. Leaving this up in case somebody wants to know what a 96 is worth in bits.

topics.title: Anybody got a carb off a Tecumseh 8hp
topics.author: n_bramley

posts.author: n_bramley
posts.body:
Tecumseh HM80, the carb is shot, the bowl gasket goes every three weeks and now the float pin has worn its hole oval.

A whole carb, or a whole engine I can rob one off. Coyne Flats.

posts.author: merv_t
posts.body: [url=synth://dermotts-smallengine.synth/]Dermott's[/url] rebuilt one for me in the spring. Forty dollars and it came back better than the new ones.

posts.author: n_bramley
posts.body: Rang them. Six weeks, he says, because it is October and everybody remembers their snowblower in October.

posts.author: jw_sayers
posts.body: I have got an HM80 in the shed out of a chipper, seized solid, but the carb was fine when it stopped. Yours for nothing if you come and get the whole engine, because I am not standing there undoing it.
posts.signature: Sayers, Ashkettle. Wood is sold by the cord.

posts.author: n_bramley
posts.body: Got it. Carb was fine. Engine went in the back of the truck and it is now my problem instead of his, which he said twice while we were loading it.

topics.title: Firewood 2011 -- who has got seasoned and what are they asking
topics.author: jw_sayers

posts.author: jw_sayers
posts.body:
Starting this early because last year it started in November and half of you were burning wood that was cut in August.

Mine: $170 a cord seasoned, ash and a bit of oak, delivered inside ten miles of Ashkettle. Stacked is $20 more and I will stack it properly, not in a heap you have to restack.
posts.signature: Sayers, Ashkettle. Wood is sold by the cord.

posts.author: n_bramley
posts.body: $160 here, mixed, Coyne Flats, you collect. Cut two winters ago.

posts.author: b_stannard
posts.body: What is a cord. I have been quoted for a face cord and I do not know if I am being had.

posts.author: jw_sayers
posts.body:
A cord is 4 foot by 4 foot by 8 foot, stacked, which is 128 cubic feet.

A face cord is 4 by 8 by however long the pieces are, so if he is cutting 16 inch that is a third of a cord. If he is quoting you a face cord at cord money, yes, you are being had.
posts.signature: Sayers, Ashkettle. Wood is sold by the cord.

posts.author: b_stannard
posts.body: He said a cord and delivered what I now think was about a third of one. I have stacked it and measured it and it is 4 foot by 9 and a bit, 16 inch pieces.

posts.author: b_stannard
posts.body:
He brought another two loads on Thursday without saying anything about it.

So he knew.

posts.author: gnash_88
posts.body: They all know. There is no honest way to be vague about a cord, it is a box, you can measure a box.

posts.author: adace
posts.body: Anybody still got any. I have left it too late, as usual.

posts.author: jw_sayers
posts.body: I have got green. You can have green at $130 and burn it next year, or you can buy seasoned off somebody in January at $240 and pretend you planned it.
posts.signature: Sayers, Ashkettle. Wood is sold by the cord.

topics.title: Splitter -- borrow, hire, or go halves
topics.author: adace

posts.author: adace
posts.body: Is there anywhere in the county that hires a log splitter by the day. The hire place in Marchfield has stopped doing them, the man said they come back broken.

posts.author: jw_sayers
posts.body: They do come back broken. Mostly because people run them with the fluid low and then say nothing.
posts.signature: Sayers, Ashkettle. Wood is sold by the cord.

posts.author: p_ogilvy
posts.body: Four of us went halves on one in 2010, twenty-two horse, and we keep it at mine and it goes round in a rota. It has never been broken and it has never been cleaned.

posts.author: adace
posts.body: Is there room in the rota.

posts.author: p_ogilvy
posts.body:
There is now. One of the four moved to Ardo in the spring and has not asked for his share back, so you can have his weeks and we will settle up if he ever turns up.

He will not turn up.

There is a vape shop in the Kestrel now. The bird is still up on the pole.

I drove past on purpose to see if they had taken it down and they have not, and then I sat at the lights feeling silly about having driven past on purpose.

They cannot take it down. The sign is older than the ordinance and a new one would cost more than the lease.

That is the only reason it is there and I will take it.
